name: MonarchCheckboxGroup
title: CheckboxGroup
summary: A labelled set of checkboxes for picking any number of choices, with an optional tri-state Select all.
whenToUse: When people may pick any number of related choices from a short list: notification channels, working days, export columns.
whenNotToUse: For exactly one choice use MonarchRadioCardGroup or radio rows. For a single yes or no use MonarchCheckboxRow. For a long, searchable list use a multi-select picker.
api: @Composable fun <T> MonarchCheckboxGroup(options: List<MonarchCheckboxGroupOption<T>>, value: List<T>, onValueChange: (List<T>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, orientation: MonarchCheckboxGroupOrientation = MonarchCheckboxGroupOrientation.Vertical, enabled: Boolean = true, required: Boolean = false, invalid: Boolean = false, selectAll: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, selectAllLabel: String? = null)
class MonarchCheckboxGroupOption<out T>(value: T, label: String, description: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true)

options.name: options
options.description: The choices, in order. Each has a value, a label, an optional description and enabled.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with every checked value, always in the order of options.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the group. Inside your own MonarchFormField, pass the field's control modifier.

options.name: orientation
options.description: One choice per line, or side by side and wrapping onto further lines.

options.name: enabled
options.description: false disables every choice and Select all.

options.name: required
options.description: Marks the label as required and adds "Required" to the group's name. The group does not enforce a minimum.

options.name: invalid
options.description: Draws the boxes in the danger color. Also on whenever errorText is given.

options.name: selectAll
options.description: Adds a tri-state Select all row above the choices, which are indented under it.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label and TalkBack name of the group. With a label the group is drawn inside a MonarchFormField.

options.name: helperText
options.description: Help text under the choices. Drawn only with a label.

options.name: errorText
options.description: The error message, shown under the choices and set as the group's error. Drawn only with a label.

options.name: selectAllLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in string monarch_checkboxgroup_select_all, "Select all".

states.name: default
states.description: Each choice is a checkbox row with its label and optional description.

states.name: select all
states.description: Select all is checked when every enabled choice is checked, partly checked when some are, unchecked when none are.

states.name: disabled choice
states.description: The row is drawn in the disabled colors, ignores taps, and keeps its state when Select all is pressed.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every row and Select all are disabled.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The boxes use the strong danger color and, with a label, the error text is shown under the group.

appearance: Material 3 checkboxes beside body text, with descriptions in muted caption text. An invalid group draws its boxes in the strong danger color with the danger on-strong tick; otherwise the boxes use the accent as in every Material checkbox. The label and the error are those of MonarchFormField. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web group can be controlled or uncontrolled and submits each value under a form name; on Android the value is hoisted and there is no form submission. The web takes the label, description, error and disabled state from a surrounding Field; on Android pass label, helperText and errorText to the group, which draws a MonarchFormField itself, or leave label null and put the group in your own MonarchFormField. The web disabled option is enabled = false on the option, following Compose. The web aria-controls link between Select all and the choices has no TalkBack equivalent. iOS has no entry yet; the names follow the web.
accessibility: Each choice is one row with the Checkbox role, its label as name and its on or off state; the whole row is the target and is at least 48dp high.
Select all is a TriStateCheckbox row whose state is on, off or indeterminate (partly checked).
A disabled choice and a disabled group are reported as disabled and ignore taps.
With a label, the group is named by it (with "Required" when required) and carries the error; a new error is announced by MonarchFormField's polite live region.
An invalid group is shown by the error text, not by color alone.
Labels wrap at the largest font size, also in the horizontal layout.
edgeCases: Values not in options are dropped from the next onValueChange.
With every choice disabled, Select all is disabled.
Values must be unique within the group; two options with the same value are toggled together.

examples.title: With select all
examples.template:
MonarchCheckboxGroup(
    options = listOf(
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption({{options.0.value}}, {{options.0.label}}, description = {{options.0.description}}),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption({{options.1.value}}, {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption({{options.2.value}}, {{options.2.label}}),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption({{options.3.value}}, {{options.3.label}}, enabled = !{{options.3.disabled}}),
    ),
    value = channels,
    onValueChange = { channels = it },
    selectAll = {{selectAll}},
    label = {{label}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchCheckboxGroup(
    options = listOf(
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption("email", "Email", description = "To your sign-in address."),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption("sms", "Text message"),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption("push", "Push notification"),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption("post", "Post", enabled = !true),
    ),
    value = channels,
    onValueChange = { channels = it },
    selectAll = true,
    label = "Notify me by",
)

examples.title: Days side by side
examples.code:
MonarchCheckboxGroup(
    options = listOf("Mon", "Tue", "Wed").mapIndexed { i, day -> MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(i + 1, day) },
    value = days,
    onValueChange = { days = it },
    orientation = MonarchCheckboxGroupOrientation.Horizontal,
    label = "Working days",
)
